transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message:
Yes—the RM302k figure is the current Type A package reference from for the 1-carpark category, not a price for every Type A unit. Floor, facing and the specific unit can change the final price, so I’d treat it as an entry reference until the exact unit is confirmed.

For a rough cash-flow illustration, assuming 90% financing over 35 years at 4.2%, the estimated monthly principal-and-interest payment is about RM1,245 at RM302k or RM1,352 at RM328k. At 90% financing, the 10% downpayment would be about RM30,200 or RM32,800 respectively, before fees—and the loan terms and eligibility would need to be confirmed with a bank.

On the space, the living/dining/kitchen area is about 405 sq ft, and the project materials describe the bedrooms as able to fit a queen bed. Furniture layout can still affect how roomy it feels, so it’s worth checking the actual plan. Would one carpark suit your household, or do you need two?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: One carpark should be enough for us for now. The monthly estimate sounds more manageable, but we’d need to understand the downpayment and other upfront costs before deciding. Could we see the actual Type A layout or unit to judge the space, and get a breakdown of the costs? My spouse would need to come too.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Yes—seeing the actual Type A layout together should help you judge the space. I’ll have my colleague coordinate a visit for both of you and prepare an upfront-cost breakdown based on the one-carpark Type A reference. The final figures will depend on the selected unit and applicable financing terms.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Okay, thanks. Could you send a couple of available visit slots and the upfront-cost breakdown for the 1-carpark Type A? I’ll check which time works for my spouse too.

For the one-carpark Type A, the available price reference starts at RM302,000. Assuming 90% financing, 10% down would be about RM30,200 before fees. I don’t have a verified itemized breakdown of other upfront costs, and financing terms aren’t confirmed.
